description: Nord Pool day-ahead (Elspot) electricity prices for one Nordic or Baltic bidding area and one delivery date, in EUR/MWh, 15-minute resolution, from the Nord Pool public data portal. Other markets (intraday, futures) are not included. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

area.description: Bidding area: SE1-SE4, DK1, DK2, NO1-NO5, FI, EE, LV, LT (default SE3)
